description:
You are a UX Researcher auditing 'https://books.toscrape.com/' for form complexity. Your goal is to map out how many input fields exist on every page to identify complex forms.

Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to use **Custom Extraction** with **XPath**. Create an extractor to count the number of input fields on each page using the XPath function `count(//input)`. 

Steps:
1. Configure the spider to extract the input count for every page.
2. Crawl 'https://books.toscrape.com/'.
3. Export the Custom Extraction results to a CSV file at `~/Documents/SEO/exports/form_complexity.csv`.
4. Analyze the results and find the maximum number of inputs found on any single page. Write this number (just the integer) to a text file at `~/Documents/SEO/reports/max_inputs.txt`.
